caption: The drawing depicts a wooden cabinet rendered in brown tones with fine shading to suggest depth. The cabinet has a prominent, angled cornice at the top. Below the cornice, the upper section consists of four vertical panels, each bordered by trim. The lower section of the cabinet features eight drawers arranged in two horizontal rows, four drawers per row. The drawers are accented with small round handles or knobs, and the two columns of drawers on either side are separated by a narrow vertical panel. The cabinet is drawn in three-quarter view showing two sides, with the right side angled backward, providing a sense of perspective. The cabinet is centered on a plain, light beige or cream background, and the artist's name "Raymond E. Neil" is written in small text beneath the cabinet.
title: Cabinet
